scope: Local unsharpened Jupiter development comparison; reference is not truth; no default percentage is selected automatically.

rows.role: development comparison; reference is not ground truth
rows.registration_method: Gaussian 1.5px amplitude correlation with subpixel peak fit

selection.ranking: strictly above capture quality-range cutoff; screening still applies

decision: Keep midpoint selection optional. The goal remains better reconstruction using more frames. This estimator retains 1645/3749 (43.88%) at the midpoint after screening, not the 75% reported for AutoStakkert. Against the prior all-screened result, matched RMS improves slightly while fine-detail correlation decreases; this does not establish better reconstruction from more frames.
